fcitx5Indicator.This plugin reads the input method state:
This plugin reads the input method state through fcitx5-remote and busctl.

Install fcitx5 (which provides fcitx5-remote) and systemd (which provides busctl), make sure they are on PATH, then enable the plugin again.
